messages:
From: Emma Li <emma@tinkerlab.io>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 09:18:04 -0800
Subject: Pilot credits + Dedicated conversion questions

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the intro last week — TinkerLab has been running a 6-week accelerator pilot on the hosted API and it’s gone well. A couple of packaging/billing questions came up from our CFO ahead of a potential move to a small Dedicated pool for a production pilot: 

1) We have $20k in accelerator credits remaining. Is there a straightforward way to convert those to a credit that applies to Dedicated (reserved) billing if we commit?
2) If we convert, can we keep some credits as a buffer for burst days (we expect a few heavy inference days during demo week)?
3) Procurement asks: can billing start be delayed for 30-45 days post-sign so we can align expenses with the next funding milestone?

I’ve attached a short exec summary of our expected usage (TinkerLab_Exec_Summary.pdf). Alex Torres from our lead investor looped in for visibility.

Appreciate any options you can share — we’re aiming to finalize by the end of November.

Best,
Emma Li
Head of Product, TinkerLab
emma@tinkerlab.io

--
Attachment: TinkerLab_Exec_Summary.pdf (application/pdf, 180 KB)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma@tinkerlab.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 11:05:27 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot credits + Dedicated conversion questions

Hi Emma — great to hear the pilot is trending well. Short answers up front, then a recommended path.

Quick options:
- Convert credits to an invoice credit: We can convert accelerator credits into a one-time invoice credit that applies to Dedicated billing if the commitment is executed within 90 days. That credit can be applied to compute charges (token spend) or to the first invoice(s) up to the credit amount.
- Split-bucket approach (recommended for your use case): Keep a portion of the credits earmarked as a burst buffer (covering peak-day token spend up to an agreed threshold) while converting the remainder to a one-time offset against the Dedicated commitment.
- Short-term burst voucher: For demo-week spikes we can provision a temporary voucher (30-day validity) to cover excess GPU time at a modest top-up fee.

A few implementation details we’ll need from you: current 7-day peak tokens, expected demo-week spike multiplier (x2/x3), and whether your procurement needs a PO / purchase order number before we send the amendment.

I attached a draft term sheet for the conversion so you can see the mechanics (conversion_term_sheet_v1.pdf). I’ll outline a mutual action plan below if that sounds reasonable.

Mutual action plan (proposed)
- You: send 7-day usage snapshot + preferred split (e.g., keep $5k buffer, convert $15k) — by Tue 24 Nov
- Us (Sales & Finance): produce a pricing calc and a short amendment showing the committed Dedicated SKU, discount, and how credits are applied — by Wed 25 Nov
- Legal: prepare amendment / DocuSign for signature — target Thurs 26 Nov
- Billing: delay billing start 45 days post-sign if procurement requests it (we can do a 30-day standard delay and extend to 45 with finance approval)

I’ll loop in Sales Ops for the exact numbers but wanted to put this on your radar.

Neha Kapoor
Senior Manager, Startup Programs | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Subject: Internal: Proposed pricing calc for TinkerLab (do not forward)

Internal note — sharing proposed numbers so we can move quickly once Emma confirms. Please keep internal until we have final numbers for the amendment.

Assumptions:
- Target Dedicated SKU: Dedicated-XS (2x A10G-equivalent GPUs)
- Expected steady usage: ~120M tokens/day (burst to 350M tokens/day during demo)
- List price estimate (Dedicated-XS): $9,000 / month

Proposal:
- 6-month commitment => 30% discount off list (net $6,300 / month)
- Apply converted credits ($14k) to first invoice(s) as one-time invoice credit; remaining $6k held as burst buffer voucher for 30 days
- Billing start delay: approve 45-day delayed billing start post-sign (Finance to accept)

Why this fits: keeps TinkerLab’s runway protected through demo week while giving Redwood predictable commit and a pathway to convert to a larger Dedicated pool if they scale.

Next: please confirm we can offer the 30% discount and billing hold — if yes I’ll build the pricing worksheet and send to Neha to share with TinkerLab.

Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Emma / Ben — thanks everyone. Confirming the agreement and next steps: 

1) Offer: 6-month Dedicated-XS at 30% discount (net $6,300/mo).
2) Credits: Convert $14,000 of accelerator credits into a one-time invoice credit applied to Month 1 and Month 2 invoices (applied sequentially until exhausted). The remaining $6,000 will be issued as a 30-day burst voucher to be used for high-traffic days during demo week.
3) Billing start: Billing will be delayed 45 days from the amendment signature date. Finance will issue a short acknowledgement prior to DocuSign execution.
4) Legal: We will produce a short amendment (DocuSign) covering the committed SKU, discount, credit application, and billing start delay. Expected signature timeline: within 3 business days of amendment delivery. Link will be shared once Legal finishes the boilerplate.

Next actions (owner / ETA):
- Emma: confirm PO number (if required) / sign-off on the split amounts by EOD Wed 25 Nov
- Ben: finalize the pricing worksheet and attach to amendment (ETA Wed 25 Nov)
- Neha / Marissa: coordinate with Finance and Legal to prepare DocuSign and billing hold (ETA Thu 26 Nov)

If Emma confirms PO timing we’ll trigger Sales Ops for a formal SOW and the DocuSign envelope. Appreciate the quick turnaround — happy to hop on a 20-min call if you want to walk through numbers.
